newsitem.title: USA: T.V.G enjoined from acting at meeting.
newsitem.headline: T.V.G enjoined from acting at meeting.

text.p: Israel-based T.V.G. Technologies Ltd said on Tuesday that a temporary injunction was issued by the Tel-Aviv District Court to prevent the company from taking action at its October 7, 1996 annual meeting.

The injunction prevents Shlomo Ostersetzer, Israel Ofen and Dov Zeelim from selling any of the company's shares held by TAT Technologies Ltd, the controlling shareholder of T.V.G. Technologies, the company said. Ostersetzer, Ofen and Zeelim are members of TAT and T.V.G.'s management.
T.V.G. said it was not able to take action on the investment by the company in Telegate Ltd, elect directors or grant options to Ostersetzer, Ofen or Zeelim.
The injunction was commenced by certain shareholders and a hearing on the matter has been scheduled for October 20, 1996, T.V.G. said.
